GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (30 Apr 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1643)
APO 500
30 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Establishment of a Reception Center at Yokohama.
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. No. 2100(RF) dated 26 March 1947, subject as above.
2, The plan to establish a reception center and quarantine station at Nagahama is approved.
3, The Commanding General, Eighth United States Army is taking the necessary steps to release the Nagahama area to the Imperial Japanese Government for use as indicated above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
